decision_conditions: <p>The parent Barnet planning application is withdrawn - no further assessment required&nbsp;</p>
description: Consultation for neighbouring authority: London borough of Barnet: Reference 25/0315/S73: Variation of conditions 1 (Approved Plans) and 37 (Use) of planningpermission reference 22/5827/S73 dated 19/02/24 (variation of 19/1049/FUL) for 'Demolition of existing building and erection of a mixed use building between four and twelve storeys high, comprising of 100 residential units with 1718.8sqm of Class A1/D2 uses at lower ground, ground floor and part first floor levels. Associated amenity space, refuse storage, cycle stores and provision of 4no. disabled parking spaces at lower ground floor level (with space for an additional 6 as needed).'  variation to include changes to the wording of condition 37 to allow the use of the rear ground floor to be used as Class E
